scoring_justification: Output contains only final computed numbers; no raw band-structure or dielectric-function data to recompute from. Comparing self-reported values to paper gold with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for band gaps, dielectric constants, EELS peaks and gap character for Be3N2, Mg3N2, Ca3N2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables 1 and 2 (EELS peak positions, dielectric constants) and text description (band gaps and direct/indirect character).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact numeric values as reported in the paper's computed results (GGA-PBE without scissor shift or spin-orbit coupling).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken directly from the paper's published tables and descriptive text; they are the same results the reproduction task aims to replicate.

outputs.description: Computed optical properties and band gaps for the three nitrides; values are compared against the paper's reference data with tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported values with noise-tolerant reference values derived from published data. No gold values or tolerances are exposed.
